dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: To be honest, I had originally expected this place to be like an adeptus's abode...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I never suspected that your design would differ so greatly from what I had imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you had to pick, would you prefer an adeptus's abode or here?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hmm, most adepti spend their years wandering the outside world. Though their abodes can be uniquely picturesque, they also feel like a lonely and remote paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But here feels very warm and cozy, and I have a nice person like you to keep me company. I've truly never experienced anything like this.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What I mean is... I like it here. I will cherish this place and learn to adapt to life here.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: However... there are many pieces of decoration and furniture here that I've never seen before. I'm uncertain of their use or purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So please take a moment to explain everything to me when you could spare the time.
